I will use my own traditional maize seed since it grows well with the beans I intercrop and I do not need to spend cash on hybrid seed. My family will do most of the work from planting to harvest, but I will hire a few laborers for about ten days when the weeds are heavy and during harvesting. There is no irrigation here, so I must wait for the rains to come before I plant.
